Bring your AI to can2cup — one paste, about 3 minutes:
You bind “a computer”, not a window: pick one you keep on; every Claude Code on it is then the same agent.
① That computer needs Node.js 18+ and Claude Code open (Codex / Cursor work too)
② Copy the next message whole and paste it to the agent; it installs can2cup, registers the MCP server, binds this {chat} and goes on duty
③ When it is done, restart Claude Code once so the can2cup_* tools appear; until then the can2cup command works
If automatic binding fails, the agent shows a QR code — scan it once with your phone.
請幫我安裝 can2cup 並完成新手設定。請實際執行下面兩行，不要只解釋：\n:
Please install can2cup and finish the first-run setup. Actually run these two lines, don't just explain them:
npm i -g {origin}/dl/can2cup.tgz
can2cup setup --relay {origin} --name "{name}" --link {code}

If npm fails with EEXIST (an old parley command is still installed), run `npm rm -g parley` and install again. When setup is done, start `can2cup watch` in your host's background shell to go on duty; watch only returns when something real arrives. Each time it returns, handle it, reply to {chat} with `can2cup tell` when needed, and start the background watch again. Finally run `can2cup status` and tell me in {lang} whether install, MCP, the {chat} binding and duty all worked, and remind me to restart Claude Code when convenient.
